title: Mishkat al-Masabih
author: al-khatib-al-tabrizi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Khatib al-Tabrizi's expansion of al-Baghawi's Masabih al-Sunna, arranging reports by topic for devotional and ethical reading. Each section separates sound reports from weaker ones and supplies the isnad and a short appraisal.
historicalContext: Compiled in Tabriz in the early fourteenth century and widely used in the Persianate and Ottoman lands. It became one of the most copied hadith anthologies for ordinary religious reading.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
